intro: Gate 2 settles the wordmark's width and ampersand B as refined (DR-71). Each piece below appears twice at actual size, first at today's width and then at the condensed width, both carrying ampersand B. Today's width stays in force until you choose.

The studio recommends today's width and B as refined. At the same height the condensed drawing gains nothing a reader needs, it sits close to the lettering of campaign signs, and its monogram reads as 0&A (D2-30).

groups.label: The marks at a glance
text: The wordmark from each of its masters, the stacked lockup and the monogram, at the same height in both widths.

items.label: Both widths
items.caption: Same height, so the difference shows as width: 152 against 120 px from the 16 px masters.

groups.label: Masthead on the site
text: L3 in the 1440 px bar, with the phone bar under it. Both widths sit at the same height, so the condensed bar is shorter by 40 px.

items.label: Today's width
items.caption: L3 from the 24 px master, 221 px wide, and a 52 px lockmark.

items.label: Condensed width, for Gate 2
items.caption: L3 from the condensed 24 px master, 181 px wide, and the same lockmark.

groups.label: Masthead in email
text: L3 at the head of a 600 px email. In a sent email it is a PNG at twice size with the alt text Oath & Action.

groups.label: Avatar
text: The monogram, L8, on the Charcoal tile that R13 sets as the default, in a circle and a square. Feeds draw an avatar at about 32 to 48 px, where L8 at either width sets its capitals under the 14 px floor; ampersand B alone reads there and is the same at both widths, so the studio recommends B for avatars whichever width you choose.

items.label: Today's width
items.caption: L8 fills 62 percent of the tile's width.

items.label: Condensed width, for Gate 2
items.caption: Same width, so the condensed capitals stand taller; its narrow O reads close to a zero.

groups.label: Social card
text: The 1200 by 630 link-preview card, with a hinge headline whose ampersand takes the card's working red. No web address until the site is settled (DR-55).

groups.label: Letterhead
text: US Letter, 8.5 by 11 inches, at true size on screen (96 px to the inch). The print proof holds both widths, one per page; check its scale with a ruler before you judge it on paper.

items.label: Today's width
items.caption: Invented address, recipient and letter, signed with Dustin's name and title.
